summary: The [October 2019 preprint supplement](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/biorxiv/early/2019/10/10/794792/DC1/embed/media-1.pdf?download=true) reports 29 unique genes for estradiol benzoate versus vehicle. All 29 agree in direction with HypoExplorer (Pearson 0.9310, Spearman 0.9138). All 29 meet the authors’ adjusted P < 0.05 threshold, and 16 meet registered FDR < 0.05. The proposal passed validation. No ledgers were edited.
openIssues: The selected table falls one numerical pair short of the 30 required by author-concordance-v2.
The complete author DESeq2 table was not located. Genome-wide overlap, raw P values and unrounded adjusted P values remain unassessed.
